en: I wanted to get as far from home as the world allows.
zh: 我想走到这个世界允许的最远。
第 1 天，北京，0 公里。
然后是布宜诺斯艾利斯，19000。

en: On a round world, that is almost as far as you can go.
zh: 在一个圆的世界上，差不多已经走到头了。

en: And from there, every road leads home.
zh: 从那儿起，哪条路都通向家。

en: It turns out, the far side of the world is just the long way home.
zh: 原来世界的另一头，只是绕远路回家。
